sheet.title: P&IDS IRRIGATION EQUALIZATION TANK P&ID
sheet.issue_status: DESIGN/BUILD DOCUMENTS - prepared for submission to EPA in July 2021 to provide a general understanding of the project concept; not intended to reflect design requirements
legend_notes: Sheet 21 of 25. CAD filename P-401.DWG. Revision table is blank.

Two horizontal dash-dot lines divide the sheet into bands. Only the upper line is labelled (SCADA): trapezoid symbols above it are SCADA points. The band between the two lines carries no label; LI 401, LAH 402 (circle-in-square) and LI 402 (circle with solid bar) sit in it. Items below the lower line are field.
Arrowheads into/out of SCADA and panel symbols are drawn either open or filled (apparently discrete vs analog); no legend on this sheet.
A diamond marked 'I' (interlock) sits on the data-link bus; it carries no tag and no output to any final element is drawn on this sheet.
No line numbers, pipe sizes, valves or equipment tags are printed on this sheet. Equipment is labelled only CONTACT BASIN and TANK.
Flag 'HYPOCHLORITE SOLUTION' carries no 'REF SHT' drawing reference; recorded as a boundary.
